name: keepwarm
description: Idle-session guard for Claude Code's 1-hour prompt cache (macOS): about 50 idle minutes after the last turn of a large session it notifies you, optionally after a cache-read fork judges whether to compact, keep warm or leave it; every request and change it makes is audited. Derived from cache-tax (MIT, Karan Bansal).

idleCheck.title: Idle check
idleCheck.description: What happens ~50 minutes after the last turn of a large session. notify: a free reminder only. judge: first ask a fork of the session (billed at the cache-read rate, about $0.03-0.10 at 100-400K tokens) whether to compact, keep warm or ignore. off: nothing. /keepwarm idle overrides this.

remindMinContext.title: Minimum context for the idle check (tokens)
remindMinContext.description: Sessions smaller than this get no idle check: a cold rewrite of them is cheap.

skipGroups.title: Sidebar groups without idle check
skipGroups.description: Comma-separated names of desktop sidebar groups whose sessions are never judged, kept warm or compacted (chats used once and left). Case-insensitive.

skipScratch.title: Skip sessions with no project
skipScratch.description: Sessions started with no project (the + beside This computer), which run in a folder the app made for them, are never judged, kept warm or compacted.

pingLimit.title: Max keep-warm pings per session
pingLimit.description: Safety net: at most this many pings per session within pingLimitHours (one every 55 minutes is 13 in 12 hours). Reaching it stops keep-warm and, with alerts on, notifies you.

pingLimitHours.title: Ping limit period (hours)
pingLimitHours.description: The rolling period pingLimit counts over.

dailyBudgetUsd.title: Daily budget for automatic requests (USD)
dailyBudgetUsd.description: What keepwarm may spend a day on requests you did not ask for (idle judges, pings of windows it opened, its compactions). Past it the idle check is skipped until midnight and, with alerts on, you are notified. 0: no limit.

awayMinutes.title: Away after (minutes)
awayMinutes.description: Phone push is sent only when the Mac has had no keyboard or mouse input for this long.

ntfyConfigFile.title: ntfy config file
ntfyConfigFile.description: Path to a JSON file {"server": "https://ntfy.sh", "topic": "...", "reply_topic": "..."} for phone notifications; with reply_topic they carry buttons (compact / keep warm / leave it). Empty: no phone push.
